name: astrograph-monorepo
author: Rodolfo Robles
description: Local-first code graph — tree-sitter base + language enrichers (see ROADMAP.md)

scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '*' typecheck && bun run typecheck:eval
scripts.build:all: for t in darwin-arm64 darwin-x64 linux-x64 linux-arm64; do echo "building $t" && bun build packages/cli/src/bin/astrograph.ts --compile --target=bun-$t --outfile dist/astrograph-$t || exit 1; done
scripts.release:checksums: cd dist && if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256sum astrograph-* > SHA256SUMS; else shasum -a 256 astrograph-* > SHA256SUMS; fi && cat SHA256SUMS
scripts.install:local: bun run build && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && install -m 755 dist/astrograph ~/.local/bin/astrograph && ~/.local/bin/astrograph --version
